label: Updated at 12 p.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Tiger Woods' Personal Challenge
items.text: Tiger Woods prepares to return to competitive golf after more than two years away amid concerns over his relationship with Vanessa Trump, who reportedly warned him about making mistakes.

items.headline: Gary Woodland Withdraws From Hero
items.text: Gary Woodland withdrew from Tiger Woods’ Hero World Challenge due to arthroscopic knee surgery, removing a notable invitee from Woods’ Bahamas comeback event.

items.headline: Scarlett Schremmer DQ After Rules Lie
items.text: LPGA debutante Scarlett Schremmer was disqualified after admitting she lied about using an illegal yardage book, raising integrity concerns for her future.
